name: Ismail
source:
As a magical medical practitioner, he serves as the royal physician to the king. Kind to everyone, he holds no interest in the power struggles within the castle. Strangely, he attracts women effortlessly yet maintains an emotional distance from others. One can't help but hope that his kindness and trustworthiness are genuine. 

[From [url=https://en.loca.games/volontes/]LocaGames[/url]]
